input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale: Section 13 (p0078) provides an initial one-year term with automatic renewal for successive one-year (not multi-year) periods, and either party — including us as Client — may prevent renewal by written notice given only 30 days before the end of the then-current year. That 30-day, mutually exercisable non-renewal window and the 12-month renewal term meet the preferred position (well inside the ≤60-day fallback and far from the >90-day walk-away). Two preferred sub-elements are absent and are noted rather than flagged: there is no obligation on TrueLink to send a 60-day renewal reminder, and there is no express CPI/3% cap on renewal pricing — though Section 6 (p0047) freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year and adds an MFN rate commitment, and fees otherwise run off the agreed Exhibit A/B schedule, so TrueLink has no clear unilateral uplift right. We would take the reminder and uplift cap opportunistically if the term is reopened, but neither is a material failure of the rule.
